items.title: Walter Booker and Jimmy Cobb interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 30, 1995
items.q: We had a band, I was with one of Cannonball Adderley’s first bands, him and Nat, and Junior Mance and Sam Jones and myself.

ctx.x: Tell us about your concept of time and color.

Well my concept is just to try to keep it lively and keep the time together, and try to keep everybody inspired if possible. You know, try to help them through their improvisation. Just try to be there, be there for them. And you know, at all times. In this band they depend on it a lot. And every band I guess, you know, but this band has a lot of energy. I mean Nat’s band has a lot of energy, so he expects it every night.
